AreaAccess.title: AreaAccess
AreaAccess.description: Distances from a listing (or its locality centre) to the area's amenities, in code.

AreaIssue.title: AreaIssue
AreaIssue.description:
One part of an area that could not be loaded; shown to the investor, never hidden as empty
(ADR 0019, after gscode007's F-05 branch).

CompetitorReading.title: CompetitorReading
CompetitorReading.description: What nearby same-category businesses mean for one property type (ADR 0023).

Listing.title: Listing
Listing.description: A discovered, de-duplicated property candidate. Every factual field is `Sourced`.

Portal.title: Portal
Portal.description: Where a candidate came from: one of the searched portals, or Google Maps.

PriceObservation.title: PriceObservation
PriceObservation.description: The price a listing was quoted at when one run saw it.

ProfileOptions.title: ProfileOptions
ProfileOptions.description: Everything the profile form offers, so the UI never hard-codes choices (CHECKLIST F-01).

PropertyDetail.title: PropertyDetail
PropertyDetail.description:
Everything known about one property as one run judged it, for the detail page
(CHECKLIST F-07). Run-scoped because the verdict, metrics and score belong to that run's
profile and are frozen with it (docs/decisions/0021-run-scoped-property-detail.md).

PropertyType.title: PropertyType
PropertyType.description:
Grouped from the listing portals' own categories (NoBroker's site, 99acres), so search
queries use the portals' vocabulary.

ROIMeasure.title: ROIMeasure
ROIMeasure.description: What the profile's target ROI is compared against (docs/decisions/0010-roi-definition.md).

SerpEngine.title: SerpEngine
SerpEngine.description: SerpApi engines the platform uses. See docs/SERPAPI_USAGE.md for what each one does.

TargetSuggestionIn.title: TargetSuggestionIn
TargetSuggestionIn.description: The profile fields a suggestion depends on; the wizard knows them by its Money step.

Verification.title: Verification
Verification.description: The LLM's judgement of one listing against one investor profile (CHECKLIST F-03).
